items.reason: The investigational intervention is the device: 'Determine the safety of Tumor Treating Fields (TTFields) started concurrently with 5 fraction stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS) and temozolomide'; devices (TTFields) are an excluded intervention type in §1.2, temozolomide is background, gadolinium is diagnostic. The manual gives no explicit precedence between the S6 reasons, so this is a judgement.

items.proposed: No selection biomarker; IDH does not count
items.reason: IDH wild type / 1p19q non-codeleted only defines 'molecular GBM of lower grade that will be treated as per glioblastoma (defined as IDH wild type, 1p19q not co deleted)', i.e. a diagnostic criterion, which §5 excludes from any_molecular_selection.

note: S6 reason for device-only trials (TTFields + standard drugs) needs a consistent convention; excluded_intervention_type proposed here. Temozolomide given as a shortened 8-day course with 5-fraction SRS could alternatively be established_therapy_experiment (would suggest established_therapy_only), but the record frames TTFields as the question. cns5 (priority 3) kept per tie rule: molecular GBM requires IDH wild type.
